description.zh:
分页查询时每页行数。最大值为100。

默认值：

- 当不设置值或设置的值小于20时，默认值为20。

- 当设置的值大于100时，默认值为100。
description.en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100.

Default value:

- If you do not set this parameter or you set it to a value less than 20, the default value is 20.
- If you set the value to greater than 100, the default value is 100.
The type of the network test.

description.zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的 NextToken 参数值。
description.en: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. Set this parameter to the value of \`NextToken\` that is returned in the last response.
The ID of the resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eflo-controller list-net-test-results --next-token 3a6b93229825ac667104463b56790000 --max-results 20 --net-test-type DelayTest --resource-group-id rg-acfmxno4vh50000 --region cn-hangzhou
